messages:
chris (Support): forwarding a customer report — they hit a persistent SSO + device-trust reauth loop after our edge deploy. User sees "verify device" repeatedly even though device is enrolled. Happens only behind their corporate proxy.

anika (Support): thanks — can you paste minimal repro steps and the request/response headers? does clearing cookies help? any user ids/tenant?

chris (Support): repro steps from user (pasted):
1) Login via SSO -> redirected to our app
2) App calls /device/assertion to check device trust cookie
3) Response sets device_trust, but browser still shows verify flow

User-agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) Chrome/121.0
Tenant: corp-acme
Example curl they ran:
```
curl -i -L 'https://portal.corp-acme.com/login' \
  -H 'Host: portal.corp-acme.com' \
  -c cookies.txt -b cookies.txt
```
Response snippet they captured: 
```
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Set-Cookie: device_trust=eyJ..; Path=/; Domain=portal.corp-acme.com; HttpOnly; Max-Age=31536000
```
Note: SameSite and Secure flags missing in their capture. They say clearing cookies sometimes helps for a few minutes then reauth loop returns.

devon (SRE): interesting — sounds like our cookie attributes are getting stripped or rewritten by the customer proxy, or we are setting Domain too specific so cross-subdomain checks fail. Can we get the edge logs for that session id? Also need the raw response from our origin before the proxy and the response after the proxy.

chris (Support): provided two headers files (origin_vs_edge.txt). quick diff: origin includes `Set-Cookie: device_trust=..; Domain=.corp-acme.com; Secure; SameSite=None; HttpOnly; Path=/; Max-Age=31536000` but edge shows `Set-Cookie: device_trust=..; Domain=portal.corp-acme.com; HttpOnly; Path=/; Max-Age=31536000` — Secure and SameSite dropped, domain rewritten.

idp-bot: deploy 2024-11-02T03:24:11Z - edge-proxy v2.7 rolled to region-us-east-1 (services: ingress, rewrites).

alice (ENG): that matches a recent edge rewrite rule change — the proxy will canonicalize host header and in some configs replace Domain on Set-Cookie. If Secure/SameSite are removed, modern browsers will treat cookie differently (and cross-site assertions may not be sent). Temporary mitigation: ask customer to ensure TLS termination preserves Secure flag (X-Forwarded-Proto or proxy config) or add a passthrough rule for Set-Cookie. Long-term: we'll add a header to opt-out of cookie domain canonicalization for idp/device cookies.

devon (SRE): quick repro you can run from their network:
```
curl -i -H 'Host: portal.corp-acme.com' \
  --location --cookie-jar cj.txt \
  'https://portal.corp-acme.com/.auth/check'
```
Look at `Set-Cookie` in the final response. If Secure/SameSite=None are missing, proxy is mutating. Also check whether `X-Forwarded-Proto` is present in origin requests.

anika (Support): advised the customer: 1) clear cookies, 2) ask their proxy team to preserve Set-Cookie attributes or whitelist our origin for passthrough, 3) as a short-term workaround use incognito or a different hostname that bypasses the rewrite. Also requested exact timestamp of failures so SRE can pull edge logs.

edgebot: support ticket #78912 — edge team applied a config patch to preserve Set-Cookie for paths starting with /device, rolled at 2024-11-02T08:02:00Z.

chris (Support): relay to customer — they tested and report the loop stopped after the patch. They said clearing cookies + one login worked, then device trust persisted. :tada:

alice (ENG): follow-up action: create an internal RFC to add opt-out header `X-Redwood-Preserve-Set-Cookie: true` and a test in our integration suite to ensure proxies don't strip Secure/SameSite for auth cookies.

anika (Support): leaving steps in ticket: repro curl, collect origin vs edge headers, request proxy whitelist, recommend clearing cookies for affected users. Marking as resolved pending monitoring. :eyes:

chris (Support): closing thread — customer confirmed stable. Good catch on the rewrite rule. :thumbsup:
